remarks: Experience convenient one-level living in this spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home at Candlelight Terrace. This newly updated unit is move-in ready. The layout offers generous living and dining areas, ample closet space, and abundant natural light throughout.  Step out onto your private patio to enjoy peaceful water views and the soothing sound of the nearby Rippowam River-a tranquil setting perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  Common charges include heat, hot water, flood insurance, and an on-site superintendent. This pet-friendly community features beautifully maintained grounds, an in-ground pool, and designated grilling areas. Additional highlights include extra storage and ample parking, all just minutes from the dining, shopping, and entertainment of downtown Stamford.
